units.source_text: 然而，那種無法向任何人訴諸的孤獨氣息，卻被眾多女性本能地嗅出，

en.t: However, that aura of loneliness which I could not confide to anyone was instinctively sensed by many women,

units.source_text: 這也是多年後，我常常被女人乘虛而入的誘因之一。

en.t: and this was one of the reasons why, years later, women so often took advantage of my weakness.

units.source_text: 也就是說，對於女人，我是一個能守得住戀愛祕密的男人。

en.t: In other words, to women, I was a man who could keep the secrets of love.

units.source_text: [1]出自梵語，「八熱地獄」中最為殘酷的地獄之一，又稱「無間地獄」。

en.t: [1] From Sanskrit; one of the cruelest of the Eight Hot Hells, also known as Avici Hell.

units.source_text: [2]兩位博士都是《少年俱樂部》雜誌（已停刊）連載的《滑稽大學》裡的人物。

en.t: [2] The two doctors are both characters in Kokkei Daigaku, serialized in the magazine Shonen Club, which is now discontinued.
